scope: Static reverse engineering; no sample execution or network contact.

WannaCry launcher: PE64 launcher.dll exports PlayGame at RVA 0x11a4.
PlayGame constructs C:\WINDOWS\mssecsvc.exe, reads W/101 resource, writes its length-prefixed executable and calls CreateProcessA with CREATE_NO_WINDOW.
Embedded executable contains WannaCry kill-switch, service configuration and encrypted resource archive. No exploit behavior is inferred from the launcher DLL alone.
Parite: Both PCRat hosts have identical grafted backward DWORD-XOR loaders.
Loader restores original entry RVA 0x4eb1, reads HKCU Explorer/PINF, extracts appended DLL at file offset 0x2c1dc, and invokes Initiate.
Key 0x00432266 decrypts the 0x2b000-byte DLL; its modified UPX stream was emulated only to recover decompressed bytes, then relocation words were restored.
PCRat: Installer and embedded Server.dll retain PCRat Update and PCRatStact identifiers.
Installer code at VA 0x40327e allocates remote memory, 0x403299 writes the payload and 0x4032db creates a remote thread.
Service creation at VA 0x402077 uses auto-start type 2 and svchost/netsvcs configuration.
corrections: Neutral PE layout and VERSIONINFO observations relocated to metadata; generic APIs and path references relocated to capability directories.
API co-occurrence no longer claims self-copying, ordered staging, file infection or shell use without supporting evidence.
PCRat is a native Gh0st variant; the previous njRAT-lineage comment was incorrect.
Shared-code RunningRAT signature disabled after matching identified PCRat server code.
